facts.fact: The DHIS2 for Education profile for Eswatini is subtitled 'Aggregate and individual EMIS data connected to national identity', and describes the EMIS (aggregate) and SEMIS App (individual learner and staff data, PIN-based) as national in scale since a 2020 pilot.
